frame: ICRS (J2000) equatorial: right ascension and declination in degrees, parallax in mas (distance in parsecs = 1000 / parallax)

multiples.plxFrom: where a star's parallax is not its own Hipparcos one: a close companion's (HIP n, measured better), or a cited source's id

bsc_hip.csv.adql: SELECT b.HR, b.HD, h.HIP, n.Plx, n.e_Plx FROM "V/50/catalog" AS b JOIN "I/239/hip_main" AS h ON b.HD = h.HD JOIN "I/311/hip2" AS n ON h.HIP = n.HIP

hip_25pc.csv.adql: SELECT n.HIP, n.RArad, n.DErad, n.Plx, n.e_Plx, h.Vmag, h."B-V", h.SpType, h.HD FROM "I/311/hip2" AS n JOIN "I/239/hip_main" AS h ON n.HIP = h.HIP WHERE n.Plx > 40

hip_all.csv.adql: SELECT n.HIP, n.RArad, n.DErad, n.Plx, n.e_Plx, n.pmRA, n.pmDE, h.Vmag, h."B-V", h.CCDM FROM "I/311/hip2" AS n JOIN "I/239/hip_main" AS h ON n.HIP = h.HIP
